description: Lists the custom dimensions and metrics of a GA4 property with the API names to use in run_report (e.g. "customEvent:payment_type", "customUser:plan"). Set include_standard to also list built-in dimensions/metrics (large; combine with search).

include_standard.description: Also return built-in dimensions and metrics. Default false.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID, e.g. "123456789" or "properties/123456789" (not the G-XXXX measurement ID). get_account_summaries lists them.

search.description: Case-insensitive filter on API name, UI name and category, e.g. "item" or "revenue".

name: get_custom_dimensions_and_metrics
title: Custom dimensions and metrics
